findings.issue: The fix adds a DB migration. Migrations are on the R6 blast-radius denylist: a loop fix may never touch one without a forced human gate. The brief's skip_paths lists db/migrate/**, and the skip was refused (brief.skip_refused), so the file was reviewed.
The retry guard re-reads the Invoice twice; one read is enough.
The log line names the Invoice by id only; the Workspace id would make it searchable.
The new early return has no test of its own; the retry spec covers it indirectly.
The constant name SEND_ONCE reads as a flag rather than a lock key.
findings.withheld_reason: nit cap (review_brief max_nits=3): a low finding beyond the code owner's nit cap; kept here, not posted and not counted as open
